title: Project states & relationships
question: What changes, and what connects to what?
description: Connect tasks, states, people and resources. Explore shared project models, process diagrams and the relationships behind a portfolio.

title: Decisions & trade-offs
question: What are we deciding, and what do we give up?
description: Frame a decision, compare competing objectives, and inspect what buffer, delay assumptions and new information change.

title: Delivery dynamics & feedback
question: How does the project change as work happens?
description: Explore dependency loops, learning, rework, reviews and site occupancy through deliberately small models.

title: Data, evidence & assurance
question: What would make the picture trustworthy?
description: Match methods to the available information. Examine data maturity, project controls and what earlier prediction experiments could establish.

title: Capabilities & futures
question: What capabilities do we need, and what might change?
description: Explore the practices, capabilities and tools a portfolio might need, with earlier reading, framework guides and clearly labelled future scenarios.
